explanation: Track a head index and count in a circular array. Enqueue writes at (head+count) modulo capacity. When full, copy logical queue order into a doubled array. Dequeue advances head without shifting elements.
timeComplexity: O(1) amortized enqueue; O(1) dequeue and size; O(capacity) constructor.
spaceComplexity: O(initial capacity + peak queue size) because the backing array does not shrink.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
